item.title: AI adoption in public sector urban planning: Aspirations and realities in London and Beijing
item.content:encoded:
European Urban and Regional Studies, Ahead of Print.
This paper examines the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in public sector urban planning through a comparative analysis of London and Beijing. Drawing on rapid qualitative methods combining interviews with public sector planners and related actors ...
